jetons.creerAide: An agent token lets the agent on your workstation write in Rationarium on your behalf, with your rights and never more.
jetons.libelleAide: The name of the workstation or agent, to recognise it in the list.
jetons.typesAide: No box ticked: the agent may perform every action type. An action of an unticked type is refused and nothing is written.
jetons.validiteAide: Leave empty for the default duration: {jours} days.
jetons.joursBornes: The validity must be a whole number of days, between 1 and {max}.
jetons.echecCreation: The token could not be created.
jetons.vide: No agent is connected to your account yet. Create a token to connect one.
jetons.creeMention: Rationarium only keeps the token's fingerprint.
jetons.uneSeuleFois: This token will never be shown again. Copy it now and store it in the keyring of the workstation where the agent runs. If you lose it, revoke it and create another one.
jetons.copie: The token is copied to the clipboard.
jetons.copieImpossible: The clipboard is unavailable: select the token in the field and copy it by hand.
jetons.ouLeRanger: The reference agent reads the token from the RATIONARIUM_JETON variable, or from the system keyring.
jetons.creeResume: It expires on {expire}. Allowed action types: {types}.
jetons.revoquerTexte: The agent using the token “{libelle}” will be refused from its next request. A run it may have taken will not be able to finish. The token cannot be restored: you will have to create another one.
jetons.revoquerMention: What the agent has already written stays in place.
jetons.echecRevocation: The token could not be revoked.

suivi.chapeau: What the agent must read to keep this project up to date, and what it has already written.
suivi.aucunPlanAide: The agent does not follow this project yet. Describe what it must read, then create the plan.
suivi.lectureSeule: Only the project owner edits its follow-up plan: its creator, its lead or its sponsor.
suivi.conflit: The follow-up plan was changed in the meantime, perhaps by the agent. It has just been reloaded: redo your changes on this version.
suivi.consigneAide: What the agent must know about this project, in plain language: what matters, what to ignore, who decides.
suivi.sourcesAide: What the agent reads on your workstation. Rationarium reads no source itself: it passes the list to the agent.
suivi.aucuneSourceAide: Add an email query, a repository, a folder, a channel, a feed or a page.
suivi.aucuneSourceLecture: The project owner has declared no source.
suivi.designationRequise: Enter the query, the repository name, the path or the address.
suivi.silenceAide: After this number of days without a signal, the agent flags the project. Leave empty to never flag it.
suivi.silenceBornes: The threshold must be a whole number of days, between 1 and 365.
suivi.planActifAide: Runs covering all followed projects include this project.
suivi.planSuspenduAide: The plan is kept, but runs no longer cover this project.
suivi.echecEnregistrement: The follow-up plan could not be saved.
suivi.corrigerChamps: Correct the flagged fields before saving.
suivi.rienAEnregistrer: The follow-up plan is already up to date.
suivi.dernieresActions: Latest agent actions on this project
suivi.aucuneAction: The agent has not written anything in this project yet.

reglages.modeRelaisEx: the agent runs on the workstation
reglages.modeDesactiveAide: Disabled, the module does not exist: no menu entry, no screen, no scheduled job, and the agent gateway answers “not found”.
reglages.modeRelaisAide: The agent runs on each user's workstation, with its own language model client. Rationarium makes no outbound network call for the module.
reglages.cronInvalide: A cron expression has five fields separated by spaces: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
reglages.planificationAide: Runs start at these times, in the organisation's time zone, for every user who has an active follow-up plan and a valid token.
reglages.sansPlanification: Empty: no scheduled run. Runs only start manually.
reglages.jalonObligatoire: Every task created by the agent is linked to a milestone
reglages.jalonObligatoireAide: The agent links every task it creates to a milestone of the project, existing or created in the same action. A task without a milestone is refused.
reglages.jalonFacultatifAide: The agent may create tasks without a milestone: they will not appear on the roadmap.
reglages.actionsParPassage: Maximum number of actions per run
reglages.actionsParPassageAide: Beyond it, the run's actions are refused. The limit guards against a runaway agent.
reglages.plafondBornes: The limit must be a whole number, between 1 and 1,000.
reglages.conservationAide: After this period, evidence excerpts are erased. The source, the reference and the date remain.
reglages.conservationBornes: The duration must be a whole number of days, between 30 and 1,830.
reglages.validationProjetsAide: A project proposed by the agent is only created once its owner approves it, in the “Agent activity” screen. The milestones and tasks that refer to it wait with it. All other actions are still written directly, and can be undone as before.
reglages.sansValidationAide: The agent creates its projects directly, like its other actions. Each creation remains traced and can be undone.

erreurs.defaireRefuse: The item's service refused to undo the action.
erreurs.plafondActions: The run has reached the maximum number of actions.
erreurs.typeNonAutorise: This token does not allow this action type.
erreurs.referenceEnDouble: Two actions of the same batch carry the same reference.
erreurs.referenceInconnue: The action refers to a reference that no previous action declared.
erreurs.actionDefaite: This action has already been undone: the agent does not redo it.
erreurs.jalonObligatoire: A task created by the agent must be linked to a milestone of the project.
erreurs.debutNonAtteste: The project must start on the date of one of the action's pieces of evidence.
erreurs.cibleIntrouvable: The item targeted by the action does not exist.
erreurs.actionNonValidable: This action cannot be approved: only a pending project creation can be approved or rejected. It may already have been decided.
erreurs.projetNonCree: The project this action depends on could not be created.
erreurs.rejeteeParProprietaire: Project creation rejected by its owner.
